prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a parking lot collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1037; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours are a little high for this damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The rear bumper cover is cracked across its center with the left tail lamp housing broken, and the left quarter panel shows a dent with paint scuffing consistent with the reported contact in the lot. The damage pattern lines up with the impact as described, and I found no sign of older repairs or prior damage on this vehicle. The plan calls for replacing the bumper cover and tail lamp, repairing and refinishing the quarter panel, and a wheel alignment check. The labor hours on the estimate run a little high for this scope, so I have asked the shop to review them. The parts invoices show single entries with no repeated charges.
